app.name: Labyrinth
app.tagline: Draw a maze. Solve theirs. Fewest walls hit wins.

auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHint: {min, plural, one {At least # character.} other {At least # characters.}}

errors.replayNotReady: Your run can be replayed once the match is over.
errors.replayExpired: This replay is no longer available. Replays are kept for a month after a match ends.
errors.notSignedIn: You need to sign in to do that.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.mazeLimitReached: You have reached the limit of labyrinths you can keep. Delete one to make room.
errors.mazeIsSubmitted: This labyrinth has been submitted and can no longer be changed.
errors.runNotUnlocked: The runs have not unlocked yet.
errors.moveOutOfOrder: That move arrived out of order. Your view has been refreshed.
errors.matchCodeMalformed: A join code is 6 letters and digits.
errors.matchFull: That match already has two players.
errors.resultNotReady: The result is not ready yet.
errors.alreadyInMatch: You are already in that match.
errors.mazeInvalid: That labyrinth is not playable yet.
errors.mazeSettingsMismatch: That labyrinth does not match this match's size.
errors.mazeAlreadyFaced: Your opponent has already played that labyrinth.
errors.alreadySubmitted: You have already submitted a labyrinth.
errors.matchNotDrawing: This match is not accepting labyrinths.
errors.matchNotCancellable: Only a match still waiting for an opponent can be cancelled.
errors.draftChangedElsewhere: This labyrinth was changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version.

labyrinths.title: Your labyrinths
labyrinths.name: Name
labyrinths.empty: You have not drawn any labyrinths yet.
labyrinths.readOnly: This labyrinth has been used in a match, so it can't be edited. You can reuse it in other matches of the same size.

matches.title: Your matches
matches.empty: You have no matches yet. Create one, or join a friend's with their code.
matches.codeHint: 6 letters and digits, from whoever created the match.
matches.sizeAndGates: {cells, plural, one {# square} other {# squares}}, {gates, plural, one {# gate} other {# gates}}
matches.cancelConfirm: Cancel this match? The join code will stop working.

format.coordinateNotAnInteger: A coordinate must be a whole number.
format.coordinateOutOfRange: That square is outside the board.
format.gateIdNotAnInteger: A gate number must be a whole number.
format.unknownVersion: This labyrinth was saved in a format we no longer read.
format.cellCountNotAPreset: That is not one of the available sizes.

validate.duplicateCell: A square has been painted twice.
validate.boundingBoxTooLarge: The labyrinth measures {width} by {height} squares; it must fit within {max} by {max}.
validate.disconnectedShape: Every square must join the others — no floating islands.
validate.startNotInShape: The start must sit on a painted square.
validate.treasureNotInShape: The treasure must sit on a painted square.
validate.startIsTreasure: The start and the treasure cannot share a square.
validate.keyOnStart: A key cannot sit on the start square.
validate.keyOutsideShape: The key for gate {gate} is not on a painted square.
validate.cellHoldsTwoThings: The square at {x}, {y} holds two things.
validate.segmentOutsideShape: A wall or gate at {o} {x}, {y} has nothing on one side.
validate.duplicateSegment: Two things sit on the same edge at {o} {x}, {y}.
validate.gateIdsNotContiguous: Use gates 1 to {expected}, each exactly once.
validate.gateIdReused: A gate number has been used twice.
validate.gateWithTwoKeys: Gate {gate} has more than one key.
validate.keyWithoutGate: There is a key for gate {gate}, but no such gate.
validate.treasureUnreachable: There is no route from the start to the treasure.
validate.incomplete: Place a start and a treasure to finish.

editor.savedAndReady: This labyrinth is saved and ready to be used in a game.
editor.saveFailed: Your changes could not be saved.

lobby.title: Match
lobby.waitingForOpponent: Nobody has joined yet. Share your code and they can.
lobby.youDraw: Choose the labyrinth your opponent will solve.
lobby.opponentDrawing: Your opponent is still choosing theirs.
lobby.noneEligible: You don't have any labyrinths you can use for this match.
lobby.confirmSubmit: Use {name} in this match? After that it can't be edited, but you can reuse it in other matches.
lobby.abandoned: This match was abandoned. Nobody won.
lobby.forfeited: You ran out of time on this one.
lobby.opponentForfeited: Your opponent ran out of time.

run.rule: Fewest bumps wins. Walking is free — walking into a wall or a locked gate is a bump. Equal bumps is a draw.
run.hint: Arrow keys or WASD to move.
run.announceWall: Blocked by a wall. {penalties, plural, one {# bump} other {# bumps}} so far.
run.announceGate: Gate {gate} is closed. You need its key. {penalties, plural, one {# bump} other {# bumps}} so far.
run.finishedWaiting: You found the treasure with {penalties, plural, one {# bump} other {# bumps}} in {moves, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}}. The result is revealed once your opponent finishes or runs out of time.
run.confirmGiveUp: Give up? {name} wins immediately, and this cannot be undone.
run.finishPending: The result is revealed when your opponent finishes or runs out of time.

result.reasonTie: Same number of bumps — it's a draw.
result.reasonYouTimedOut: You ran out of time before finding the treasure.
result.reasonOpponentTimedOut: {name} ran out of time before finding the treasure.
result.reasonAbandoned: The match expired before it was decided.
result.reasonAbandonedYou: The match expired, and you ran out of time.
